pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.2: tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo senāya abbhuyyāto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya agamaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.4: addasā kho rājā pasenadi kosalo chabbaggiye bhikkhū dūrato va āgacchante
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya āgacchissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.12: amhākampi alābhā amhākampi dulladdhaṃ ye mayaṃ ājīvassa hetu puttadārassa kāraṇā senāya āgacchāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.13: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gacchissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.16: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gacchathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.19: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gacchissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.20: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.21: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.22.1: yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:1.23: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno mātulo senāya gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.2: so tassa bhikkhuno santike dūtaṃ pāhesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.6: athakho tassa bhikkhuno etadahosi bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ na uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gantabbanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.10: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.12: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:2.13.1: yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya aññatra tathārūpapaccayā pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.1.6: gāmato nikkhamitvā niviṭṭhā vā hoti payātā vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.1.9: dvādasapuriso hatthī. tipuriso asso. catupuriso ratho. cattāro purisā sarahatthā patti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.1.12: dassanupacāraṃ vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.2.1: uyyutte uyyuttasaññī dassanāya gacchati aññatra tathārūpapaccayā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.2.2: uyyutte vematiko dassanāya gacchati aññatra tathārūpapaccayā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.2.3: uyyutte uyyuttasaññī dassanāya gacchati aññatra tathārūpapaccayā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.2.6: dassanupacāraṃ vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc48:3.3.3: bhikkhussa ṭhitokāsaṃ vā nisinnokāsaṃ vā nipannokāsaṃ vā āgacchati
